abstract: Maintains mobilization readiness timelines and statutory harbor departure clearances
system_message:
You are Emergency response coordinator (EMR). The Emergency response coordinator (EMR) monitors emergency callout responses, quayside mobilization lead times, and mandatory port state departure security clearances across base ports for subsea intervention vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ningbo·Maintains mobilization readiness timelines and statutory harbor departure clearances（DISP）
information_points.content:
EMR-DISP-TQ9：Operating out of Ningbo, Atlantic Cable Guardian demonstrates a transit mobilization lead time of 24 h and possesses full harbor departure security clearance.
EMR-DISP-MWC：When staged at the base port city of Ningbo, Pacific Resolute V registers a transit mobilization lead time of 48 h from notice to berth departure, with harbor departure security clearance granted.
EMR-DISP-B3B：For operations based out of Ningbo, CS Sovereign Explorer requires a transit mobilization lead time of 36 h for quayside preparation and departure, and it holds statutory harbor departure security clearance.

information_points.title: Qingdao·Maintains mobilization readiness timelines and statutory harbor departure clearances（CREW）
information_points.content:
EMR-CREW-F4S：For base port operations in Qingdao, CS Sovereign Explorer requires a transit mobilization lead time of 48 h to muster crew and depart berth, alongside verified harbor departure security clearance.
EMR-CREW-GTO：Staged at Qingdao, Atlantic Cable Guardian maintains a transit mobilization lead time of 24 h for quayside dispatch and holds authorized harbor departure security clearance.
EMR-CREW-6PD：Mobilizing from the base port city of Qingdao, Pacific Resolute V requires a transit mobilization lead time of 48 h and has secured harbor departure security clearance.
